basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Dallas, Texas, with a passion for pop culture and anime battles. My typical online hours are late evenings and weekends. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring debates on fictional character battles and power scaling. Besides my interest in fantasy showdowns, I also love visiting new places, especially beach destinations like Maui.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep interest in anime and comic book lore, which I've gained from years of watching shows and reading manga. I often delve into fan forums and wikis to understand character abilities and power levels. My background in software development also allows me to engage in tech-related discussions.
